status: declared development initial-information regime; no learning result yet
motivation: Cold-prior failures retained: uncertainty over every route prevents the compact planner from reaching B. The user-motivated passage question also merits testing when outer alternatives have been surveyed previously.
common_prior: Both methods receive exactly the same archived noisy wind observations on both outer route curves before mission time zero. These are an explicit initial-information assumption, not free measurements acquired during the mission. No passage-core wind values are supplied.
selection_rule: Inspect posterior calibration and known-outer/unknown-passage contrast before planner comparisons. Keep both outcomes. Do not select on proposed-vs-passive cost, inject oracle route costs, freeze passive real updates, or reset clarity during the mission.
negative_control: A separately labeled prior survey that also covers the passage can later test low value of further learning, using the same task and physics.
scope: This regime assumes historical wind information on outer routes. Any resulting benefit must not be generalized to a completely uninformative initial belief. The original cold-prior failures remain part of the study.

data_supported_followup.reason: Reference POAM initializes inducing locations from observed training locations. Uniform unobserved centers left surveyed routes unnecessarily uncertain.
data_supported_followup.initialization: 24 pivoted-Cholesky inducing locations from 42 archived outer-route observations; same data for both arms; no central observations.
data_supported_followup.selection: The existing std=0.8 remains the main development configuration; std=1.5 failure retained. This is not held-out evidence.
